challenges.title: Reverse a String
challenges.description: Write a function that reverses a string. The input is a string and you should return the reversed string.
hints: Think about what operations you can do on strings
Try converting the string to an array first
JavaScript: split(''), reverse(), join(''). Python: s[::-1]

challenges.title: Sum of Array
challenges.description: Write a function that returns the sum of all numbers in an array.
hints: You can use a loop to add each element
Python has a built-in sum() function

challenges.title: FizzBuzz
challenges.description: Write a function that returns 'Fizz' for multiples of 3, 'Buzz' for multiples of 5, 'FizzBuzz' for multiples of both, and the number itself otherwise.
hints: Check for FizzBuzz (divisible by both) first
Use the modulo operator (%) to check divisibility

challenges.title: Palindrome Check
challenges.description: Write a function that checks if a string is a palindrome (reads the same forwards and backwards). Ignore case.
hints: Compare the original with the reversed version
Think about how you solved 'Reverse a String'

challenges.title: Find Maximum
challenges.description: Write a function that finds the maximum value in an array of numbers without using built-in max functions.
hints: Start with the first element as the current max
Loop through and update max when you find a larger value
Handle the edge case of a single-element array
